quam ex me referre. Toletus in lib. 8. ph. c. 10. tex.
86. q. de illis ita loquitur: Neque vero Peripatetico-

l.i: rum inventum proprium fuit, imo, ut ex Eugubino,

esse vas plenum Deo. Dei spiritum omnia continere,

l.i: Empedocles, cujus fit mentio in lib. de mundo, ubi

sufficiant, ut appareat contra Averrois impietatem,

page.notes: Red smudges at the left margin (near "esse", "non esse" and "Trismegisto") are not printed; they look like annotations or stains and are left out. A small mark beside "Trismegisto" in the left margin may be a printed reference sign, but it is too faint to read, so it is not transcribed. "Pauca" and "Verùm" are as printed. The running head is printed with a small mark between D and E, read as "DE". The heading is level 2 because ARTICULUS sits inside the division above.
